question: In what bodily locus does the disciple enact that transmitted knowledge?
premises: That knowledge is the object enacted by the disciple.
The disciple is included as an agent of this enactment.
The head-lotus functions as the locus of this enactment.
inference: The disciple also enacts that knowledge within the head-lotus.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taj jñānaṃ depends on the preceding context.
plain_english: O goddess, the disciple also realizes that knowledge in the lotus of the head.
